Subject: Trial recap & procurement path — next steps for billing

Hi Akira / Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to see Acme's team hit the trial success criteria (50k tokens/day with generated responses under 400ms median). Quick recap and suggested next steps so we're aligned: 

- Trial success criteria: confirmed by Sanjay (usage threshold, latency) — ok to move to billing when PO/contract is in place.
- Commercial path options: PO (preferred by your procurement) vs. credit card / marketplace — please confirm which you'd like to move forward with.
- Start date for billing: we can start billing on the date the PO is issued or on a mutually agreed service start date. If you want billing to start on a specific date, tell us and we'll lock it in.
- Legal / procurement asks: if your legal needs an SOW or specific SLAs, please loop them in (I've included Beth in the thread if helpful).

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and the trial scope doc (trial-scope.pdf) that reflect what we validated in the trial. Key ask: please share the procurement route (PO vs card vs marketplace) and the name of the procurement contact who will issue the PO.

If PO — we'll send a procurement pack (procurement-pack.zip) with our standard MSA + SOW + invoice instructions for your finance team. If marketplace — we can list this under the Cloud Marketplace program but that typically adds a 2–3 week lead time.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync next Tue (Mar 2) to confirm?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: we will be doing a PO through finance. Sanjay is coordinating but Beth (legal) will want to review the SOW / MSA.
- PO timeline: we should be able to raise a PO within 2 weeks once we receive the procurement pack + draft SOW.
- Billing start: we prefer billing to start on the PO issuance date (we'll provide the PO date once issued).

We did reach the usage threshold you mentioned — the trial traffic profile matched what we plan for production. We're keen to convert but need the paperwork to move forward. Please send the procurement pack and a draft SOW for Beth to review.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports receiving PO PDFs via email and whether you require a PO number on the invoice? That will speed things up on our side.
